raw:
[Subtitle(text="'The Sky is blue and fine,
The Breeze lilts by in Song;
The River murmurs clear,
My Heart is filled with Hope.
The Mist parts overnight,
The Earth welcomes Dawn's Light;
Praise be Leithanien,
Where free Men find their Home.'
—Lied des klaren Himmels (1078)", x=290, y=210, alignment="center", size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
text:
'The Sky is blue and fine,
The Breeze lilts by in Song;
The River murmurs clear,
My Heart is filled with Hope.
The Mist parts overnight,
The Earth welcomes Dawn's Light;
Praise be Leithanien,
Where free Men find their Home.'
—Lied des klaren Himmels (1078)

raw: [name="Hibiscus"](According to the map, I shouldn't be far from the Rhodes Island branch office now.)
speaker: Hibiscus
content: (According to the map, I shouldn't be far from the Rhodes Island branch office now.)

raw: [name="Hibiscus"](Got held up a bit coming into Vyseheim, but if I just hurry up, I can hopefully make it there before I'm late...)
speaker: Hibiscus
content: (Got held up a bit coming into Vyseheim, but if I just hurry up, I can hopefully make it there before I'm late...)

speaker: Passionate Infected
content: Hold it right there!

speaker: Hibiscus
content: Er... me?

raw: [name="Passionate Infected"]Yes indeed, you, beautiful Dame! You're an unfamiliar face. Could this be your first time here in the Afterglow?
speaker: Passionate Infected
content: Yes indeed, you, beautiful Dame! You're an unfamiliar face. Could this be your first time here in the Afterglow?

raw: [name="Hibiscus"]Yes, I'm a Rhodes Island Operator, here to look into the Serendipitous Infected Prognosis Phenomenon—
speaker: Hibiscus
content: Yes, I'm a Rhodes Island Operator, here to look into the Serendipitous Infected Prognosis Phenomenon—

raw: [name="Passionate Infected"]Leave behind your work and duties for now. I cordially invite you here to perform with me in song!
speaker: Passionate Infected
content: Leave behind your work and duties for now. I cordially invite you here to perform with me in song!

speaker: Hibiscus
content: Perform?

raw: [name="Hibiscus"]But I bought this concert flute as a staff. I couldn't play you a single song...
speaker: Hibiscus
content: But I bought this concert flute as a staff. I couldn't play you a single song...

raw: [name="Passionate Infected"]No matter! If you can just make it sing, I have faith I can spin your notes into a song to offer to you, Dame. Let's commemorate this fine day!
speaker: Passionate Infected
content: No matter! If you can just make it sing, I have faith I can spin your notes into a song to offer to you, Dame. Let's commemorate this fine day!

raw: [name="Hibiscus"]I have an appointment with someone, and I'm almost late as is.
speaker: Hibiscus
content: I have an appointment with someone, and I'm almost late as is.

raw: [name="Passionate Infected"]Don't worry, don't worry. Anyone would let a little delay go, with weather so fine.
speaker: Passionate Infected
content: Don't worry, don't worry. Anyone would let a little delay go, with weather so fine.

speaker: Passionate Infected
content: Come, this won't take long!

raw: [name="Hibiscus"]I... I just play some random notes then?
speaker: Hibiscus
content: I... I just play some random notes then?

speaker: Passionate Infected
content: Please!

raw: [name="Hibiscus"](Alright, alright, I can make it sound...)
speaker: Hibiscus
content: (Alright, alright, I can make it sound...)

raw: [name="Passionate Infected"]Do... fa... la.. so... fa... mi...
speaker: Passionate Infected
content: Do... fa... la.. so... fa... mi...

raw: [name="Passionate Infected"]Wonderful, a motif full with hope!
speaker: Passionate Infected
content: Wonderful, a motif full with hope!

raw: [name="Passionate Infected"]Emma, I'll play. What if you and our visitor dance a tune together?
speaker: Passionate Infected
content: Emma, I'll play. What if you and our visitor dance a tune together?

speaker: Hibiscus
content: Together?

raw: [name="Cheerful Infected"]Come, beautiful Fräulein, let us skip!
speaker: Cheerful Infected
content: Come, beautiful Fräulein, let us skip!

raw: [name="Hibiscus"]But I really don't have the time, and I'm not much of a danc—
speaker: Hibiscus
content: But I really don't have the time, and I'm not much of a danc—

raw: [name="Cheerful Infected"]No worries, we all dance poorly at times. No one will laugh at you.
speaker: Cheerful Infected
content: No worries, we all dance poorly at times. No one will laugh at you.

raw: [name="Passionate Infected"]Very well, I'll play this in three...
speaker: Passionate Infected
content: Very well, I'll play this in three...

speaker: Passionate Infected
content: One-two-three, one-two-three... ready—go!

raw: [name="Hibiscus"]I'm sorry, I trod on you so many...
speaker: Hibiscus
content: I'm sorry, I trod on you so many...

raw: [name="Cheerful Infected"]That's fine, I'm delighted to dance with you! Thank you for joining us!
speaker: Cheerful Infected
content: That's fine, I'm delighted to dance with you! Thank you for joining us!

speaker: Passionate Infected
content: Goodbye! Have a beautiful day!

speaker: Cheerful Infected
content: Welcome to the Afterglow!

speaker: Hibiscus
content: Thank you, thanks.

speaker: Woman in Operator Attire
content: Good morning, Hibiscus~

speaker: Hibiscus
content: You're... Andante? From the branch?

speaker: Andante
content: That's right! Welcome to Vyseheim's Afterglow!

raw: [name="Hibiscus"]Thank you. This is awkward, you coming out here just to greet me.
speaker: Hibiscus
content: Thank you. This is awkward, you coming out here just to greet me.

raw: [name="Andante"]I didn't come just to greet you.
speaker: Andante
content: I didn't come just to greet you.

speaker: Hibiscus
content: Eh?

raw: [name="Andante"]Word came that before you left for the Afterglow, you were piling pressure on yourself, staying up all hours of every night. You were reading papers right up until you left the landship.
speaker: Andante
content: Word came that before you left for the Afterglow, you were piling pressure on yourself, staying up all hours of every night. You were reading papers right up until you left the landship.

raw: [name="Andante"]So today, your job is entirely to relax!
speaker: Andante
content: So today, your job is entirely to relax!

speaker: Hibiscus
content: I'm actually fine.

raw: [name="Andante"]No, can't have that! Strings snap when you stretch them that thin!
speaker: Andante
content: No, can't have that! Strings snap when you stretch them that thin!

raw: [name="Andante"]Besides, you came just at the right time. Herr Czerny's farewell concert is in a week, and it just so happens today's application day.
speaker: Andante
content: Besides, you came just at the right time. Herr Czerny's farewell concert is in a week, and it just so happens today's application day.

raw: [name="Andante"]Apparently, he's performing at the plaza in front of Afterglow Hall! It'll be over if we're a moment too late!
speaker: Andante
content: Apparently, he's performing at the plaza in front of Afterglow Hall! It'll be over if we're a moment too late!

speaker: Hibiscus
content: But the mission...

raw: [name="Andante"]If this chance goes, it's gone! We can talk missions tomorrow! Let's run!
speaker: Andante
content: If this chance goes, it's gone! We can talk missions tomorrow! Let's run!

speaker: Andante
content: We're here!

raw: [backgroundTween(xFrom=0, yFrom=50, xTo=0, yTo=-50, xScaleFrom=1.2, yScaleFrom=1.2, xScaleTo=1.2, yScaleTo=1.2, duration=5, block=false)]
[name="Andante"]Afterglow Hall. They say it's this very concert hall the Afterglow gets its name from.
speaker: Andante
content: Afterglow Hall. They say it's this very concert hall the Afterglow gets its name from.

raw: [name="Hibiscus"]Is... this even a building, or is it a giant instrument...?
speaker: Hibiscus
content: Is... this even a building, or is it a giant instrument...?

raw: [name="Andante"]Enough, the Hall's not going anywhere, we'll have time to admire it later. Our focus today is Herr Czerny.
speaker: Andante
content: Enough, the Hall's not going anywhere, we'll have time to admire it later. Our focus today is Herr Czerny.

raw: [name="Hibiscus"]I think... I read about Mister, Herr Czerny beforehand. He was born in the Afterglow?
speaker: Hibiscus
content: I think... I read about Mister, Herr Czerny beforehand. He was born in the Afterglow?

raw: [name="Andante"]He was. He's still the one and only musician ever to both be Infected and renowned in Leithanien. He's even held minor tours around the country—
speaker: Andante
content: He was. He's still the one and only musician ever to both be Infected and renowned in Leithanien. He's even held minor tours around the country—

speaker: Andante
content: I see him, there he is!

raw: The musician stands on the steps outside the hall, a colossal instrument his height upright beside him.
content: The musician stands on the steps outside the hall, a colossal instrument his height upright beside him.

raw: No one stands in the five-meter semicircle around him.
content: No one stands in the five-meter semicircle around him.

raw: Outside that semicircle, the crowds teem.
content: Outside that semicircle, the crowds teem.

raw: [name="Andante"]Blow me down! Half of the Afterglow's here, at least.
speaker: Andante
content: Blow me down! Half of the Afterglow's here, at least.

speaker: Hibiscus
content: Half?!

raw: [name="Andante"]Herr Czerny used to constantly perform outdoors here, but he's been ill for half a year, and it's his first time back. You don't know how excited everyone is—
speaker: Andante
content: Herr Czerny used to constantly perform outdoors here, but he's been ill for half a year, and it's his first time back. You don't know how excited everyone is—

speaker: Andante
content: (Whisper) It's starting.

raw: With the sound of a piano, the plaza quickly falls to a hush.
content: With the sound of a piano, the plaza quickly falls to a hush.
Practically everyone stops talking.

raw: Even the peddler hawking incessantly until now lowers his voice.
content: Even the peddler hawking incessantly until now lowers his voice.
The song is short.

raw: The moment Czerny's performance ends, a mountainous applause erupts.
content: The moment Czerny's performance ends, a mountainous applause erupts.

raw: It gradually abates. While Czerny prepares to play the next song, someone neatly dressed squeezes through the crowd, and arrives at his side.
content: It gradually abates. While Czerny prepares to play the next song, someone neatly dressed squeezes through the crowd, and arrives at his side.

raw: [name="Frivolous Noble"]Herr Czerny, Dame Gertrude sends her regards.
speaker: Frivolous Noble
content: Herr Czerny, Dame Gertrude sends her regards.

speaker: Czerny
content: Oh. You, I see.

raw: [name="Frivolous Noble"]She asks me to remind you that be it an applicational affair or the concert day itself, you haven't been booked for an outdoor performance.
speaker: Frivolous Noble
content: She asks me to remind you that be it an applicational affair or the concert day itself, you haven't been booked for an outdoor performance.

speaker: Czerny
content: And what does it matter?

raw: [name="Czerny"]Other places may have their schedules, but you are hard-pressed to stop me performing for all in the Afterglow.
speaker: Czerny
content: Other places may have their schedules, but you are hard-pressed to stop me performing for all in the Afterglow.

raw: [name="Frivolous Noble"]Your health isn't the fairest. You'd best not tire yourself too much...
speaker: Frivolous Noble
content: Your health isn't the fairest. You'd best not tire yourself too much...

raw: [name="Czerny"]I know my health best. If I didn't feel better today, I wouldn't be here.
speaker: Czerny
content: I know my health best. If I didn't feel better today, I wouldn't be here.

raw: [name="Czerny"]Go tell Gertrude: mind her own business. Don't come all persnickety at me.
speaker: Czerny
content: Go tell Gertrude: mind her own business. Don't come all persnickety at me.

speaker: Frivolous Noble
content: Very well.

raw: [name="Hibiscus"]What was his problem? Why did no one say anything?
speaker: Hibiscus
content: What was his problem? Why did no one say anything?

raw: [name="Andante"]He's a retainer of Dame Gertrude Strollo.
speaker: Andante
content: He's a retainer of Dame Gertrude Strollo.

raw: [name="Hibiscus"]Gertrude Strollo... Countess Strollo, the ruler... the Lehnsfrau of Vyseheim?
speaker: Hibiscus
content: Gertrude Strollo... Countess Strollo, the ruler... the Lehnsfrau of Vyseheim?

speaker: Andante
content: The very same.

raw: [name="Andante"]But Herr Czerny sent that man packing in just a few words! What a feel-good sight.
speaker: Andante
content: But Herr Czerny sent that man packing in just a few words! What a feel-good sight.

speaker: Hibiscus
content: I see.

raw: [name="Andante"]Let's head into Afterglow Hall in a moment. Application's about to begin.
speaker: Andante
content: Let's head into Afterglow Hall in a moment. Application's about to begin.

raw: Seeing the noble's figure disappear into the crowd, Czerny clears his throat.
content: Seeing the noble's figure disappear into the crowd, Czerny clears his throat.

speaker: Czerny
content: Thank you all for your support.

raw: [name="Czerny"]Today, I came not just to play you all a passage or two, long while that it's been, but to warm up for the concert next week.
speaker: Czerny
content: Today, I came not just to play you all a passage or two, long while that it's been, but to warm up for the concert next week.

raw: [name="Czerny"]I invite you all to be enthusiastic in this application. Prove your love for music on the stage. I'll be here, supporting you all.
speaker: Czerny
content: I invite you all to be enthusiastic in this application. Prove your love for music on the stage. I'll be here, supporting you all.

raw: [name="Czerny"]I'll be at the selections tomorrow too, casting my own discerning eye.
speaker: Czerny
content: I'll be at the selections tomorrow too, casting my own discerning eye.

raw: [name="Czerny"]Now, let me play a few more pieces for you all. I welcome you to bring out whatever instruments you're good with. Whether you accompany me or play by your own tune, I welcome it all.
speaker: Czerny
content: Now, let me play a few more pieces for you all. I welcome you to bring out whatever instruments you're good with. Whether you accompany me or play by your own tune, I welcome it all.

speaker: Czerny
content: Thank you, everyone!

raw: Czerny bows, the heavy silence finally lifts, and the crowd erupts into even more fervorous applause.
content: Czerny bows, the heavy silence finally lifts, and the crowd erupts into even more fervorous applause.

raw: [name="Food Stall Owner"]Hey. You set up shop here too?
speaker: Food Stall Owner
content: Hey. You set up shop here too?

raw: [name="Coffee Shop Owner"]Damn near everyone's here at the Hall. Where else am I going to do business if not here?
speaker: Coffee Shop Owner
content: Damn near everyone's here at the Hall. Where else am I going to do business if not here?

raw: [name="Food Stall Owner"]Sure, but I don't think anyone's willing to drink your coffee.
speaker: Food Stall Owner
content: Sure, but I don't think anyone's willing to drink your coffee.

raw: [name="Coffee Shop Owner"]Easy for you to say—
speaker: Coffee Shop Owner
content: Easy for you to say—

raw: [name="Infected"]Excuse me, I'll take a tub of sauerkraut. A big one!
speaker: Infected
content: Excuse me, I'll take a tub of sauerkraut. A big one!

speaker: Food Stall Owner
content: Coming up!

raw: [name="Coffee Shop Owner"]A crowd full of anticipation, a musician forcing his ailing body along, a noble given the cold shoulder...
speaker: Coffee Shop Owner
content: A crowd full of anticipation, a musician forcing his ailing body along, a noble given the cold shoulder...

speaker: Coffee Shop Owner
content: (Whisper) Touches my heart.

raw: [name="Disgruntled Old Man"]Kreide. You still insist on applying to that concert?
speaker: Disgruntled Old Man
content: Kreide. You still insist on applying to that concert?

speaker: Kreide
content: Yes, I do want to go...

raw: [name="Disgruntled Old Man"]Fine. Don't often see you turning a deaf ear like this. You want to go, go.
speaker: Disgruntled Old Man
content: Fine. Don't often see you turning a deaf ear like this. You want to go, go.

speaker: Kreide
content: Thank you, Grandpa!

raw: [name="Grandpa"]You sign up and come straight back, don't linger outside.
speaker: Grandpa
content: You sign up and come straight back, don't linger outside.

speaker: Kreide
content: I'll try.

speaker: Grandpa
content: Try?

raw: [name="Kreide"]Apparently, entrants have to perform onstage for this application, so they can prove their skill...
speaker: Kreide
content: Apparently, entrants have to perform onstage for this application, so they can prove their skill...

raw: [name="Grandpa"]But your cello's been wrecked forever. You only have the one string to play. What are you doing about that?
speaker: Grandpa
content: But your cello's been wrecked forever. You only have the one string to play. What are you doing about that?

raw: [name="Kreide"]It's alright, they'll provide a loaner instrument.
speaker: Kreide
content: It's alright, they'll provide a loaner instrument.

raw: [name="Grandpa"]*sigh* Very, very thoughtful of them. Why did nobody tell me, hm?
speaker: Grandpa
content: *sigh* Very, very thoughtful of them. Why did nobody tell me, hm?

speaker: Kreide
content: Grandpa, are you... mad?

raw: [name="Grandpa"]What? No, I'm just a little uneasy about it.
speaker: Grandpa
content: What? No, I'm just a little uneasy about it.

raw: [name="Kreide"]I promise, I'll be back as soon as the application's over. I won't run off anywhere!
speaker: Kreide
content: I promise, I'll be back as soon as the application's over. I won't run off anywhere!

speaker: Grandpa
content: Fine, fine, I hear you.

raw: [name="Kreide"]I'll put the tea by the stove, now. Remember to drink it soon, don't let it get cold!
speaker: Kreide
content: I'll put the tea by the stove, now. Remember to drink it soon, don't let it get cold!

raw: [name="Mature Noble"]Application's beginning soon. It's about time you went.
speaker: Mature Noble
content: Application's beginning soon. It's about time you went.

raw: [name="Young Noble"]I still can't swallow this. You called me here, all the way from Urtica, specifically to have me apply to this concert full of Infected?
speaker: Young Noble
content: I still can't swallow this. You called me here, all the way from Urtica, specifically to have me apply to this concert full of Infected?

raw: [name="Mature Noble"]Such a level of interaction with Infected won't pose any risk.
speaker: Mature Noble
content: Such a level of interaction with Infected won't pose any risk.

raw: [name="Young Noble"]You don't have to tell me. I know.
speaker: Young Noble
content: You don't have to tell me. I know.

raw: [name="Young Noble"]What I mean to say is, I don't understand why you invited me here just for some run-of-the-mill concert.
speaker: Young Noble
content: What I mean to say is, I don't understand why you invited me here just for some run-of-the-mill concert.

raw: [name="Mature Noble"]You've always wanted to breathe the air of freedom, haven't you?
speaker: Mature Noble
content: You've always wanted to breathe the air of freedom, haven't you?

speaker: Young Noble
content: I can't deny that, but—

raw: [name="Mature Noble"]Don't let doubts overtake you now. Enjoy the commoners' festive atmosphere.
speaker: Mature Noble
content: Don't let doubts overtake you now. Enjoy the commoners' festive atmosphere.

speaker: Young Noble
content: (Shrug)

raw: [name="Mature Noble"]The car is ready for you. There's some way to travel from the Cliffy Patio to the Afterglow; I recommend you not go on foot, so as not to affect your performance at application.
speaker: Mature Noble
content: The car is ready for you. There's some way to travel from the Cliffy Patio to the Afterglow; I recommend you not go on foot, so as not to affect your performance at application.

raw: [name="Young Noble"]I appreciate your kindness. Farewell, Strollo—
speaker: Young Noble
content: I appreciate your kindness. Farewell, Strollo—

raw: [name="Mature Noble"]You're forgetting. I prefer my given name, not my surname.
speaker: Mature Noble
content: You're forgetting. I prefer my given name, not my surname.

speaker: Young Noble
content: I apologize, Dame Gertrude.

speaker: Hibiscus
content: What a queue!

raw: [name="Andante"]That's the line for application. We're just going with the crowds, so come this way~
speaker: Andante
content: That's the line for application. We're just going with the crowds, so come this way~

speaker: Kreide
content: Hello, can I ask...?

raw: [name="Worn-out Infected"]Here to apply, right? End of the line's there. Head over and queue up.
speaker: Worn-out Infected
content: Here to apply, right? End of the line's there. Head over and queue up.

speaker: Kreide
content: —It's so long!

raw: [name="Worn-out Infected"]Plenty of folk started queueing before the sun came up.
speaker: Worn-out Infected
content: Plenty of folk started queueing before the sun came up.

raw: [name="Kreide"]But I'm really in a rush to get my application over with. I'm still caring for my grandpa back home.
speaker: Kreide
content: But I'm really in a rush to get my application over with. I'm still caring for my grandpa back home.

raw: [name="Worn-out Infected"]No can do. Look, we're all Afterglowers. Who hasn't got someone to care for at home?
speaker: Worn-out Infected
content: No can do. Look, we're all Afterglowers. Who hasn't got someone to care for at home?

speaker: Kreide
content: Well... but...

raw: [name="Worn-out Infected"]Get in line, quick. It'll be even longer soon enough.
speaker: Worn-out Infected
content: Get in line, quick. It'll be even longer soon enough.

raw: [name="Young Noble"]Can you really not accommodate, just this once?
speaker: Young Noble
content: Can you really not accommodate, just this once?

speaker: Worn-out Infected
content: I said no. That's just—

raw: [name="Worn-out Infected"]Wait, y—you're a noble, aren't you? You're here to apply to our concert?!
speaker: Worn-out Infected
content: Wait, y—you're a noble, aren't you? You're here to apply to our concert?!

raw: [name="Young Noble"]If you see as much, then could you oblige myself and my friend here?
speaker: Young Noble
content: If you see as much, then could you oblige myself and my friend here?

speaker: Worn-out Infected
content: But we've got rules...

raw: [name="Young Noble"]Or do you plan to refuse a noble's sincerest request?
speaker: Young Noble
content: Or do you plan to refuse a noble's sincerest request?

speaker: Worn-out Infected
content: I wouldn't dare.

speaker: Young Noble
content: Thank you for your understanding.

speaker: Young Noble
content: Come, now.

raw: [name="Young Noble"]Didn't you hear me? They're letting us through.
speaker: Young Noble
content: Didn't you hear me? They're letting us through.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=15, ystrength=15, vibrato=20, randomness=70, fadeout=true, block=false)]

speaker: Kreide
content: A... Alright!

speaker: Kreide
content: But—

speaker: Kreide
content: Er, where'd he go?

speaker: Mannered Infected
content: Next, please.

raw: [name="Mannered Infected"]Can I have your name, please?
speaker: Mannered Infected
content: Can I have your name, please?

speaker: Kreide
content: People call me Kreide.

raw: [name="Mannered Infected"]What instruments are you proficient in?
speaker: Mannered Infected
content: What instruments are you proficient in?

speaker: Kreide
content: The cello.

raw: [name="Mannered Infected"]Did you come without your own cello?
speaker: Mannered Infected
content: Did you come without your own cello?

speaker: Kreide
content: I don't have one...

raw: [name="Mannered Infected"]That's fine, we provide common-use instruments to musicians. You can access them at your leisure.
speaker: Mannered Infected
content: That's fine, we provide common-use instruments to musicians. You can access them at your leisure.

raw: [name="Mannered Infected"]Alright, you may begin. Be careful not to go over one minute.
speaker: Mannered Infected
content: Alright, you may begin. Be careful not to go over one minute.

speaker: Mannered Infected
content: Is there a problem?

raw: [name="Kreide"]I didn't get to ask just now, but how do you determine pay for participation?
speaker: Kreide
content: I didn't get to ask just now, but how do you determine pay for participation?

speaker: Mannered Infected
content: Pay?

speaker: Kreide
content: Eh?

raw: [name="Kreide"]The person who told me about the concert said that so long as I was chosen, I'd get ample pay.
speaker: Kreide
content: The person who told me about the concert said that so long as I was chosen, I'd get ample pay.

raw: [name="Kreide"]My grandpa's gravely ill, and I need money for his treatment.
speaker: Kreide
content: My grandpa's gravely ill, and I need money for his treatment.

raw: [name="Mannered Infected"]I sympathize with your plight, but there is no material reward for this concert.
speaker: Mannered Infected
content: I sympathize with your plight, but there is no material reward for this concert.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.3, xstrength=30, ystrength=30, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

speaker: Kreide
content: There's no pay at all?!

raw: [name="Mannered Infected"]I believe the vast majority feel that the ultimate honorarium comes from performing with Herr Czerny at his farewell concert.
speaker: Mannered Infected
content: I believe the vast majority feel that the ultimate honorarium comes from performing with Herr Czerny at his farewell concert.

speaker: Kreide
content: How could this be...?

raw: [name="Mannered Infected"]It's your decision to perform or not. However, if you do decide to leave, I hope for you to at least leave us with a fine melody before you do.
speaker: Mannered Infected
content: It's your decision to perform or not. However, if you do decide to leave, I hope for you to at least leave us with a fine melody before you do.

speaker: Kreide
content: I... alright.
Kreide, somewhat dejectedly, bows.

raw: He slowly takes a seat, and steadies the cello between his knees.
content: He slowly takes a seat, and steadies the cello between his knees.

raw: With a hand on his bow, and the other on the strings, the dismay is all but swept from his face, leaving only concentration.
content: With a hand on his bow, and the other on the strings, the dismay is all but swept from his face, leaving only concentration.
